title: Story to change bindings

story.i_want_to: bind a chg change to the story it implements
story.so_that: a story's lifecycle can follow its change without a pull request

rationale: PRD §4. The binding is the one join both halves need; everything else hangs off it.

acceptance_criteria.description: A change_bindings table (tenant_id, story_id, repo, change_id, superseded_at) exists with RLS ENABLEd, unique on (tenant_id, repo, change_id); tenant_id is never cast.
Exactly one binding per story is current: the newest not superseded. Binding a second change supersedes the previous current one in the same transaction.
A story_id the tenant does not own never creates a binding; it is recorded as an unbound event and logged, and the answer is byte-identical to an unknown id.
Binding never writes assigned_agent_id or implementer_dispatch_id. A submitter whose session does not hold the story's claim is recorded with the flag submitter_not_claimant.

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
preconditions: two tenants, a story in tenant B
steps: bind from tenant A with tenant B's story_id
expected_results: response identical to an unknown id

test_cases.name: one current binding
preconditions: a story bound to change C1
steps: bind change C2 to the same story

test_cases.name: no re-anchor
preconditions: a story claimed by agent A
steps: bind with a submitter session that is not A's

technical_notes: Context module Loopctl.Changes; every function takes tenant_id first.
Do not add a lineage or custody field here: CLAUDE.md, custody identity is never an injectable input.
